origin: Codex 0.142.5: the relay runs out of tokens in the middle of the arguments of a tool call, after some text (finish_reason length). Codex names no output limit, so the limit is the gateway's own default (4096 tokens) which a Codex account is not held to: the answer lost the step it was taking and would end the turn with the text alone, so the gateway holds it back (WITHHELD: a 502 that is not charged, and not a failure of the relay; the relay is kept from the session) and the client's retry reaches another source. The relay answers are authored from the documented Chat Completions shapes; the expected files are what the gateway does with them.
